item.title: IAF exercise to take place over Nahariya, explosions expected to be heard
item.description:
An Israel Air Force exercise will take place Monday at approximately 6:00 a.m. over Nahariya and the surrounding area.
During the exercise, aircraft will fly at low altitudes, and sounds of explosions will be heard. There is no security threat.

item.title: Iran: Oil tanker hits naval mine and catches fire near Strait of Hormuz
item.description:
The Iranian Navy claimed that an oil tanker struck a naval mine and caught fire east of the Strait of Hormuz.
According to the Iranian military, the tanker was sailing in a prohibited area after switching off its identification systems and was operating in violation of regulations.

item.title: Iranian foreign minister threatens US: 'Choose war, and we will rain hellfire down on you'
item.description:
Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi issued an ultimatum to the White House, calling on Washington to accept Tehran's demands, including an end to the war on all fronts. He said Iran's proposal remains on the table.
"Meet our demands and you will see the results. Or choose war, and see how our experienced and battle-ready fighters rain hellfire down on you," he threatened.

item.title: IDF finds Hezbollah weapons near UN posts in Lebanon
item.description: IDF troops uncover weapons stockpiles, Hezbollah military apartment 100 to 250 meters from UN posts in southern Lebanon.

item.description: The IDF Spokesperson's Unit reported that sirens were activated in the Nir Oz area. The circumstances of the incident are being investigated.

item.title: Thousands of Chabad emissaries from 111 countries gather in a display of strength at 770
item.description: Thousands of Chabad emissaries from 111 countries gathered outside 770 in Brooklyn for their traditional group photo, held in the shadow of the deadly Sydney Hanukkah attack last year that claimed 16 lives.

item.title: US Marine veteran says Israel and America must stand together against evil
item.description: Visiting Israel Benghazi veteran Mark Geist says the fight is ultimately one of good versus evil, calls for US-Israel unity, and credits Trump's leadership as essential to achieving peace in the Middle East.

item.description: Over 140 suspects apprehended, approximately 35 weapons located during operations by the Judea and Etzion Brigades.

item.title: It's official: Eisenkot receives mandate to form Israel’s next government
item.description: Israeli President Isaac Herzog tasks Yashar! chairman Gadi Eisenkot with forming a government, after 67 MKs recommended him.

item.title: Two-year-old critically injured after being hit by vehicle in Arad
item.description:
A two-year-old boy was brought to the Magen David Adom (MDA) station in Arad after apparently being struck by a vehicle.
MDA medical teams provided emergency treatment and evacuated him to Soroka Medical Center in Beersheba in critical condition, while performing CPR. He suffered multiple traumatic injuries.

item.title: Deri resigns from Shas, will not serve in 26th Knesset
item.description: Shas chairman Aryeh Deri has decided not to serve as a member of the Knesset in the upcoming term. Two other members, Moshe Abutbul and Dror Amos, have also resigned from the party's Knesset list.

item.title: Eisenkot plans to delay swearing in government until Knesset speaker is replaced
item.description:
Yashar party chairman Gadi Eisenkot, who is expected to receive the mandate to form a government today, does not plan to swear in a new government before the Knesset speaker is replaced, even if he succeeds in forming one beforehand.
The replacement of the Knesset speaker is scheduled for next week, and Eisenkot is expected to wait until then before holding the swearing-in ceremony.

item.title: Minority Gov.? Pressure from the right on Elisaf Peretz is mounting
item.description: Amid right-wing pressure to oppose an Arab-backed minority government, Elisaf Peretz says he trusts Gadi Eisenkot to make the right decisions for Israel.

item.title: Pro-Palestinian activists replace German flag at Reichstag with Palestinian flag
item.description:
Pro-Palestinian activists replaced the German flag flying outside the Reichstag, the German parliament building, with a Palestinian flag overnight.
Footage released from the scene shows Berlin firefighters working to remove the flag several hours after it was raised.
The incident occurred one day before the 88th anniversary of Kristallnacht, the Nazi pogrom against Jews in Germany on November 9-10, 1938.

item.title: Yashar party denies report of talks on Israeli withdrawal from Lebanon
item.description:
The Yashar party has denied a report by Shlomo Rizel claiming that Gadi Eisenkot is negotiating with foreign officials over an Israeli withdrawal from Lebanon.
The party described the report as an "outright lie, completely devoid of any factual basis."
The party demanded that Channel 14 remove the report immediately and that Rizel issue a public apology. In its statement, the party claimed that the publication was intended to thwart the formation of a new government.
